name: Neural quantum states with weight-space programming

mentions.name: Neural quantum states with weight-space programming
mentions.description: This project applies recent MIT weight-space programming techniques to neural quantum states — neural networks that represent a quantum wavefunction. Using these techniques, it produced a batch of novel networks for a few hundred dollars of cloud GPU, versus the tens of thousands traditional training would have cost.
mentions.problem: Training neural quantum state networks in the traditional manner would cost tens of thousands of dollars.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been using the recent MIT weight-space programming techniques to work with neural quantum states, which are neural networks that represent a quantum wavefunction. I was able to produce a bunch of novel networks for a few hundred dollars of cloud GPU, which would have probably cost tens of thousands to train in the traditional manner.
